Team — putting together a compact day-of plan and contingency playbook for Arielle's virtual full loop next Tuesday (11/23). Key asks below; please reply with a single-line ack + any blocking notes.

High level schedule (PST):
- 09:45–10:05 — Candidate warmup (15–20m buffer; tech check + intro) — Zoom link in calendar
- 10:15–11:00 — Technical system design (Laura)
- 11:10–11:40 — Code pair (Marissa)
- 11:50–12:20 — Product & cross-team (Chloe)
- 12:20–12:40 — Break / resume buffer for candidate
- 12:45–13:15 — Wrap + hiring manager sync (Vanessa)

Contingency rules (short):
- Candidate late <= 10m: push all runs forward; keep order.
- Candidate late 10–25m: skip the product interview and do HM + two technicals; schedule a 25–35m follow-up with product if needed.
- Candidate late >25m: move to fallback date (I will coordinate with TalentOps).
- AV failure for an interviewer: use backup interviewer (see below) or continue with 1 interviewer stepping out for a silent observer and take notes — follow the Runbook.

Backups/notes:
- Backup for Laura (system design) = Marissa (can switch into design, takes 10m to prep).
- Backup for Marissa (pair) = Chloe.

Prep links / attachments: runbook + candidate resume attached. Please open the runbook and skim the 2-page debrief rubric before the warmup.

Arielle asked for a 15–20 minute mic check; I'd like to do the 9:45 warmup as 20m. If anyone absolutely cannot do 9:45, tell me now.

Thanks — V.

--
